label: Tier 1: configuration
subgoals: Identify value, table or skill-choice changes
Confirm the core validates the parameter range
Record the change as a configuration revision

label: Tier 2: plug-in at an extension point
section: Tier 2: plug-in at an extension point
subgoals: Confirm no existing parameter expresses the behavior
Locate the extension point that can host it
Build and test the plug-in without touching the core

label: Tier 3: core edits
subgoals: Identify edits to legality, propagation or interfaces
Require a human-approved diff and full regression
Try lower tiers first and refuse unsafe requests
